lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Slotted plate to middle plate fold, about 90 deg. In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the label point lies on the outer-skin arc apex, with the nearest outer points at v of about 0.00 mm and the inner skin at +2.3 to 2.46 mm along the bisector. The line runs parallel to the fold. The fold zone spans t of -0.7 to 39.4 and the line covers 0 to 39.0, about 97%. In all 22 global views and the close-up it sits on the outer apex.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Middle-plate neck to rounded tab fold, about 90 deg, bending the opposite way to B1 (Z/N profile). In sections at 25/50/75% the label point is on the outer apex at about 0.0 mm, with the inner skin at +2.3 to 2.46 mm. The line runs parallel to the fold. The fold zone spans t of -0.47 to 24.8 and the line covers 0 to 24.08, about 95% of the neck width. The face-on close-up shows the line runs across the full neck.
